item.title: [+1] Rupee falls 10 paise to 96.45 against US dollar ahead of RBI monetary policy decision
item.description:
Signal: a weaker rupee. 23 reports from BusinessLine, Upstox, CNBC TV18 and 18 more. Related: “Rupee edges lower against dollar ahead of RBI policy decision”. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 6 Oct).

Pharma & healthcare: mild tailwind (+1) — Pharma exporters gain

Why it matters: A weaker rupee raises the cost of oil and other imports and imported inflation, but lifts IT and pharma exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee −3, Inflation outlook −1, Foreign investor flows −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks
